scope: Host-side I/O primitive only; no production runtime selection or wire command admission
startup: enqueue get_state before accepting prompt; native session identity must match
writer: one worker, bounded queue, write and flush outside Host admission mutex, never retry
reader: one worker, bounded queue, LF Records with counted omissions
stderr: separate draining worker, contents discarded, never protocol or shared diagnostics
deadline: expire as unknown, close driver and require Host to stop its owned process; queued commands never replayed
approval: dispatched only after writer confirms complete write and flush; never infer native acknowledgement
cleanup: Host retains Process ownership and stops it before releasing driver; driver drops channels and cancels queued writes without blocking on joins
